name: session-status
description: Session status and focus: a fixed goal with a done line, a gate before side work (Fork/Park/Now), a resume card after pauses; what is happening now, plan progress, and the decisions Claude needs from you as hotkeys; /standing opens the full status and plan

fallbackMinSeconds.title: Fallback after (seconds)
fallbackMinSeconds.description: When a turn this long ends without a status, a fork of the conversation writes one. 0: never.

focusRules.title: Focus rules
focusRules.description: Add the focus rules to each prompt: a fixed goal and done line, a gate before side work (Fork, Park, Now, Make it the goal), and a close when done is met. Off: only the status line is asked for.

usageLog.title: Usage log
usageLog.description: Append a line to ~/.claude/usage.jsonl for each gate shown, each gate answer and each resume, to review how the gate is used. Off: nothing is written.
